author: Seung Wook
problem: jumps lists the distance in metres of every attempt at a long-jump meet, and k is between 1 and the number of attempts. Return the k-th longest distance.
bug_description: Returns ranked[k] instead of ranked[k - 1], treating k as a 0-based index, so it gives the jump one place lower (and crashes for the shortest).

comments.accurate: The k-th longest jump of the meet
comments.wrong_behavior: Distance of the jump ranked k places below the longest
comments.wrong_location: Ranking index verified; check the sort puts the longest jumps first
